said it will use the DoE funding for drilling and completing enhanced geothermal systems wells in partnership with multiple national labs, while also deploying and testing new technology for high-temperature EGS operations, extending the reach of enhanced geothermal into hotter, more demanding conditions.
In Nevada, the DoE grant will support a targeted appraisal campaign at a high-priority EGS prospect in Humboldt County to confirm the reservoir is suitable for EGS development; Fervo’s
Project Red EGS commercial pilot has been generating 3 MW of gross power to the Nevada grid since 2023.
